# Senseoza AI Digital Solutions

> Senseoza is an AI-powered digital marketing agency based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We help startups and SMEs grow through measurable SEO, paid media, content marketing, social media, AI automation, and website design. Every engagement is built around a single metric: revenue attributed to marketing spend.

Senseoza was founded in 2022 in Pune. By 2026 the studio has shipped 50+ campaigns, driven ₹10Cr+ in attributed client revenue, and earned a 4.9 Google rating. The agency combines AI-assisted research and reporting with human strategists who own every client account end-to-end.

## Services

- [SEO Services in Pune](https://senseoza.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimisation, content strategy, authority link building, and local SEO for Google Business Profile and geographic search dominance. Expected ROI: 5.3× compared to paid advertising. Leads close at 14.6% vs 1.7% for outbound.
- [PPC & Paid Ads](https://senseoza.com/services/ppc-ads): Google Ads, Meta Ads, and paid campaign management optimised for maximum ROAS. Immediate qualified traffic for businesses that need leads now.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://senseoza.com/services/social-media): Community building, content calendars, platform management, and engagement strategies that turn followers into customers across Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
- [Content Marketing](https://senseoza.com/services/content-marketing): Blog writing, website copywriting, SEO content strategy, video scripts, email newsletters, and AI-assisted content planning that establishes authority and drives organic traffic.
- [AI Marketing Automation](https://senseoza.com/services/ai-marketing): AI-driven automation tools for personalising customer experiences, scaling marketing output without scaling headcount, and real-time campaign optimisation using machine learning.
- [Website Design & Development](https://senseoza.com/services/web-design): High-converting websites built for performance, user experience, and search engines. Built on Next.js, WordPress, and custom stacks for clients across India and the US.
